study: deep5 — insider cluster buying and 180-day peaks
writtenBefore: any cluster outcome, control outcome or return was computed (only the coverage audit's cluster counts existed)

sample.main: Clock 2 (public disclosure) clusters with a fully observed 180-calendar-day window (entry date + 180 <= last complete bar), not affected by the Dec 24-31 2025 SEC gap

periods.confirm: entry date 2026-03-01 .. last date with a full 180-day window (~2026-05-07)
periods.extension: entry date after the confirm period with a full 90-day window; 90-day horizon only; not pristine (Jun-Nov prices were seen in deep studies 2-4 for other questions)

primary.test: Cluster A: mean 180d net return minus mean of its 5 matched point-in-time controls != 0 (issuer-clustered bootstrap)
Cluster A: mean 180d net return minus SPY != 0
Cluster A: share touching +20% (daily high) within 180d minus matched-control share != 0
Cluster A: mean max 180d gain (daily high) minus matched-control mean != 0

dose.test: Union: Spearman(log combined USD, 180d excess vs controls) != 0
Union: Spearman(distinct owners, 180d excess vs controls) != 0
Union: Spearman(log USD / 20-session dollar volume, 180d excess vs controls) != 0
Union: Spearman(log combined USD, max-gain excess vs controls) != 0
Union: Spearman(distinct owners, max-gain excess vs controls) != 0
Union: Spearman(log USD / dollar volume, max-gain excess vs controls) != 0

subgroups.rule: Union, 180d excess vs matched controls; difference between the two groups (issuer-clustered bootstrap). No other splits are tested; anything else is labelled exploratory.

list.split: CEO or CFO among the buyers vs not
a 10% owner among the buyers vs not
all qualifying purchases on one trade date vs spread over 2+ dates
bottom tercile of 20-session dollar volume vs the rest
fund-like issuer (name matches Fund|Trust|Income|BDC|Capital Corp, or a buyer is a Portfolio Manager/Trustee) vs operating company
SPY above its 50-session average at the decision vs below
disclosure more than 7 days after the last qualifying trade vs within 7 days
any 10b5-1 plan purchase in the qualifying set vs none
combined USD in the top third vs the rest

timing.test: Union: median days to the 180d high, events minus matched controls != 0
Union: share of 180d highs set in the last 30 days of the window, events minus controls != 0

clocks.test: Union: mean (Clock 1 hindsight 180d return - Clock 2 public 180d gross return) for the same events != 0

strategies.rule: Fixed rules, frozen now. Entry at the official open of the first session after disclosure + 60 s (09:28 MOO cut-off); liquidity-tier costs per side; exits never chosen from the observed peak. Evaluated on design, then confirm, then extension (90d only).

list.rule: every union cluster, hold 180 calendar days
Cluster B or C only, hold 180 calendar days
every union cluster, hold 90 calendar days
every union cluster, limit sell at +20% (filled only if high >= target x 1.005; gap above fills at the open), else exit at the 180-day close
union clusters in the top third of USD / dollar volume (tercile cut-offs from the design period only), hold 180 days
DISCOVERED: the pre-registered subgroup (G1-G10, either side) with the highest design-period mean 180d excess vs controls with n >= 20 events, frozen after design and tested once on confirm

strategies.pass: A rule passes only if confirm-period mean net excess vs matched controls AND vs SPY are both > 0, the issuer-clustered 90% interval excludes 0 vs controls, and at least 2 of the confirm cohort months are positive. Otherwise REJECTED or INSUFFICIENT DATA (< 20 confirm events).

multipleTesting: Benjamini-Hochberg over every p-value in this file (q < 0.10), and separately reported together with deep studies 2-4 (1,494 earlier tests).
